title: Particle flow
subtitle: Follow a paragraph’s additions, contrasts, and inferences.
overview: Particles are small but structural: καί commonly adds, δέ advances or contrasts, γάρ gives a reason, and οὖν draws an inference or moves a story on.
Do not force one English word every time. Record the relation each particle creates between clauses.

items.grc: ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει.
items.en: God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God.
Therefore Jesus said to them / Then Jesus said to them.
